title: Driver Survivor. The dead own the streets. You have a car.
author: re-skob
selftext:
Just got a Steam page up for my game Driver Survivor - a vampire survivors-like where you drive a car through the zombie apocalypse. 

I made this mostly with Astra and GPT-Sol. Models were generated with Tripo and voxelized. ThreeJS and PixiJS for the frameworks. 

I've been surprised by how much I've been able to push it. I now have over 3k zombies on screen with all weapons blasting. It's been a ton of fun and I can't wait for you all to play it.

Would love it if you wishlisted on Steam if this looks like something you'd like.  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285800/Driver\_Survivor/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285800/Driver_Survivor/)

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body: Nice work, looks really great. I would love to know the Steam process, and how you to voxels and 3d modeling in more detail. Specifically the destructive terrain

replies.author: re-skob
replies.body:
For the Steam process - you pay 100 bucks per game on the steamworks page to register, there's a steam CLI that allows you to automate uploading builds which is nice, so I had a bat script written to make it a one-click button to make my build and post it for testing (I was mainly trying to test and optimize on Steam Deck). Other than that for the store page it's just a bunch of stuff to fill out, capsule art to make and upload. When I had the Steam page ready it took around 3 business days for them to approve it (they say 3 - 5) and get the Steam page live. Before then you could preview it in the beta.

For voxelization, I generate high-res models using Tripo - the mesh density and UVs don't matter. Then I have a script that samples the geometry on a 12cm grid and samples the texture color and maps that voxel color on a 64x64 color swatch so every building is sharing a texture and material.

I brought in Box3D for the physics and use that for the destruction physics.

I have a couple dev logs that I'll be posting about the process
